questions.stem: 21 + 2w ≤ 27 A rectangle has length l and width w. The inequality gives the possible values of l and w for which the perimeter of this rectangle is less than or equal to 27. Which statement is the best interpretation of (1, W) = (8, 3) in this context?

options.A: If the rectangle has length 3 and width 8, its perimeter is less than or equal to 27.
options.B: If the rectangle has length 8 and width 3, its perimeter is less than or equal to 27.
options.C: If the rectangle has length 3 and width 8, its perimeter is greater than or equal to 27.
options.D: If the rectangle has length 8 and width 3, its perimeter is greater than or equal to 27.
